audit.species: both (mouse = primary evidence chain; human = separate, weaker evidence chain; rhesus macaque appears only in counter-evidence)
audit.what_was_measured: MOUSE (Fathman 2011, strongest link): in adult C57Bl/Ka CD45.1 mice, bone marrow Lin-CD27+CD244+Flk2- cells were split by 12-colour FACS into rNKP (CD122+) and pre-NKP (CD122-IL-7Ra+), sorted to >95% purity; (i) single cells were clone-sorted one per well into 96-well OP9 stromal cocultures and scored at day 10 for surface NKp46 (54+/-5% of rNKP wells, 40+/-2% of pre-NKP wells positive; 1 of 3 experiments); (ii) 300 sorted rNKP or pre-NKP were injected into UNCONDITIONED Rag2-/-Il2rgc-/- CD45.2 hosts and donor CD45.1 NKp46+ NK cells with a Ly49 repertoire plus ex vivo degranulation were enumerated at day 21; (iii) the same progenitors were injected intrathymically and read out at day 10 (no NK generated). MOUSE (Rosmaraki 2001, the NKP-defining paper): readout was flow-cytometric phenotype of Lin-CD122+NK1.1-DX5-Ly49- BM cells, RT-PCR for pTa/lambda5/CD3e vs IL-15Ra/Id2/GATA-3/Ets-1, 51Cr cytotoxicity of the freshly sorted population, and stromal/cytokine culture scored for outgrowth of lytic NK1.1+ cells with parallel T/B/myeloid/erythroid readouts — reported single-cell frequency on OP9 was 1/12 (this frequency quoted verbatim from Fathman 2011's Discussion, since Rosmaraki's own Methods are inaccessible). MOUSE (Kim 2002 / Chiossone 2009, the iNK->mNK link): BrdU incorporation and phenotypic ordering of CD11b/CD27/Ly49/CD94 subsets, diphtheria-toxin-induced NK ablation in NDE transgenic mice with EGFP+ recovery kinetics, microarray transcriptome proximity, and adoptive transfer of sorted EGFP+ NK subsets into unirradiated congenic recipients. HUMAN (Freud 2006): CD3-/CD19-depleted mononuclear cells from >50 tonsil and 30 lymph-node donors were sorted to >99% purity into stage 1 (CD34+CD45RA+CD117-CD94-), 2 (CD34+CD45RA+CD117+CD94-), 3 (CD34-CD117+CD94-) and 4 (CD34-CD117+/-CD94+); readouts were surface phenotype, real-time PCR for CD122/ETS-1/GATA-3/T-BET, luciferase cytotoxicity vs K562/Jurkat, IFN-g/GM-CSF/TNF-a/IL-13 ELISA, 2-5 week cultures on MS-5 or OP9-DL1 stroma with IL-15 +/- FL/IL-3/IL-7, CFU assays, and limiting dilution at 50/25/12.5/6.25/3.125/1.5625 cells per well x 10 replicates.
audit.n: Fathman 2011: 5 recipient mice per progenitor type per experiment, 3 independent experiments (~15 recipients per arm); 300 sorted pre-NKP or rNKP injected per recipient; clonal assay = 1 cell/well in 96-well OP9 plates, 1 of 3 experiments shown, exact well totals not stated in Methods. Freud 2006: >50 tonsil donors plus 30 lymph-node donors (cells from multiple tonsil pieces/LNs POOLED per donor); limiting dilution 10 replicate wells per dose. Wang 2024 (Eomes-hi NK-neg): 400-800 sorted BM precursors per recipient into sub-lethally irradiated (450 rad) Rag2-/-Il2rg-/- mice, analysed 2 weeks post-transfer; competitive transfers used 500 cells pooled from 3-5 donor mice. Rosmaraki 2001: n NOT RECOVERABLE — full text inaccessible; do not assume a number.
audit.n_unit: recipient animals (mouse, Fathman/Wang); donors (human, Freud — pooled tissue per donor); wells (clonal/limiting-dilution in vitro assays). NOT cells.
audit.controls: Fathman 2011 (good): parallel transplantation of 1000 CLP and 10,000 unfractionated BM cells as reference populations; congenic CD45.1/CD45.2 donor tracking; hosts deliberately UNCONDITIONED — "We decided to use unconditioned animals in subsequent studies because irradiated animals are known to up-regulate factors" — which removes the irradiation-artefact confound; sorted purity >95%; intrathymic sham injections used PBS alone; ex vivo degranulation to confirm functional maturity. Freud 2006 (moderate): peripheral-blood CD34+ HPC, cord-blood CD34+ cells and PB CD56bright NK as reference populations; isotype-matched control mAbs; CD3/CD19 negative-selection controls; unseeded wells as blanks in limiting dilution; parallel CFU (myeloid), OP9-DL1 (T) and DC-medium cultures as negative-lineage-potential controls; EGTA/MgCl2 and anti-TRAIL/anti-FasL blocking in cytotoxicity. Rosmaraki 2001 (reported, unverifiable): T, B, myeloid and erythroid differentiation conditions run in parallel as negative-potential controls, and mature NK subsets as positive comparators — taken from the abstract, NOT from methods I could read. Kim 2002 / Chiossone 2009: congenic markers and unirradiated recipients; details unverifiable (paywalled). Notable MISSING control across the whole claim: no experiment excludes selection/expansion of a minority pre-committed cell inside the sorted gate, because no clonal barcode or genetic lineage tag was carried through the transfer.
audit.strongest_alternative_explanation: SELECTION/EXPANSION OF A PRE-EXISTING MINORITY, NOT CONVERSION OF THE GATED POPULATION. Every step of this chain is established by transferring or culturing a BULK, FACS-gated population and recovering NK cells downstream; no experiment tags an individual NKP and watches it become an NK cell. The gates are demonstrably impure: the founding NKP definition converted at only 1/12 at the single-cell level (Fathman 2011 Discussion, of Rosmaraki's NKP), and even the 6-fold-refined pre-NKP/rNKP convert at only 40-54% — so at minimum half of every "NKP" ever transferred is something else. Wang 2024 (Nat Immunol) states outright that "previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs." Both assay formats independently favour the selection reading: OP9 stromal coculture is known to expose cryptic, non-physiological lineage potentials (Ehrlich 2011, "stromal cocultures reveal cryptic, but nonphysiologic, myeloid potentials of lymphoid progenitors"), and transfer into an empty Rag2-/-Il2rgc-/- host imposes a strong lymphopenia-driven proliferative filter that will amplify whichever pre-committed contaminant is present. A second, non-exclusive alternative is MULTIPLE INDEPENDENT ORIGINS: Fathman's own intrathymic injections generated no NK cells, "suggesting a separate origin of thymic NK cells," Sojka 2014 identifies at least four distinct NK lineages (cNK, thymic, liver/skin trNK, uterine trNK), and macaque barcoding shows steady-state mature NK compartments are maintained by peripheral self-renewal rather than by flux through an upstream progenitor. A third is TECHNICAL: the human arm rests on marker overlap and culture only, and Freud's own Discussion concedes "stages 1-4 as we defined them are likely to be functionally heterogeneous... we cannot rule out these possibilities using the techniques we used in our study."
audit.counter_evidence: 1) Wu C, Espinoza DA, Koelle SJ, ... Bryceson YT, Dunbar CE. Sci Immunol 2018;3:eaat9781. PMID 30389798 / PMC7393805 — barcoded autologous HSPC transplantation in rhesus macaques tracked >4 years: CD56-CD16+ NK clones "remained long-term clonally uncoupled from other hematopoietic lineages, including CD56+CD16- NK cells," and the authors conclude "linear NK cell production from multipotent hematopoietic progenitors or less mature CD56+CD16- cells is negligible during homeostasis and moderate proliferative stress." This is the highest-grade (clonal barcode, in vivo, primate) evidence in the whole area and it contradicts obligate linear flux. 2) Wu C, Li B, Lu R, ... Weissman I, Dunbar CE. Cell Stem Cell 2014;14:486-499. PMID 24702997 / PMC3979461 — "Clonal tracking of rhesus macaque hematopoiesis highlights a distinct lineage origin for natural killer cells." 3) Wang/Sun-lab, Nat Immunol 2024;25:1460-... PMID 38871999 / PMC11409033 — "We found that previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs"; proposes Eomes-hi NK-neg BM cells as the true cNK precursor, displacing the classical NKP node. 4) Ehrlich LIR, Serwold T, Weissman IL. Blood 2011;117:2618-2624. PMID 21163922 / PMC3062354 — "In vitro assays misrepresent in vivo lineage potentials of murine lymphoid progenitors"; a direct methodological indictment of the OP9 stromal assays that carry the NKP claim. 5) Xu W, Cherrier DE, ... Di Santo JP. Immunity 2019;50:1054-1068. PMID 30926235 / PMC6477155 — Id2-RFP reporter: "In contrast with the current model, we have demonstrated that Id2+Zbtb16+ ILCPs included multi-potent ILCPs that retained NK-cell potential" — from Di Santo's own lab, i.e. the NKP-defining group revising its own precursor map. 6) Sojka DK et al. eLife 2014;3:e01659. PMID 24714492 / PMC3975579 — "there are at least four distinct lineages of NK cells: cNK, thymic, liver (and skin) trNK, and uterine trNK cells." 7) Vosshenrich CAJ et al. Nat Immunol 2006;7:1217-1224. PMID 17013389 — thymic GATA-3+CD127+ NK pathway independent of the BM NKP (corroborated by Fathman's null intrathymic result). 8) Corat MA et al. Blood 2017;129:1940-1946 (PMID 27903532) and Schlums H et al. Blood 2017;129:1927-1939 (PMID 28209719) — in human PNH and GATA2 deficiency, adaptive NK cells persist long-term in patients depleted of stem and progenitor cells, i.e. mature NK maintenance uncoupled from HSPC input.
audit.downstream_dependency: (a) The Cd122-Cre (Il2rb-Cre) conditional-knockout driver is built directly on the premise that CD122+ NKP is THE committed NK intermediate — e.g. Theranostics 2023, PMID 37153735, "we deleted TOX at the hematopoietic stem cell stage (Vav-Cre), NK cell precursor (CD122-Cre) stage and late NK cell developmental stage (Ncr1-Cre)"; if the CD122+ gate is heterogeneous and contains PLZF+ ILCPs, the stage-attribution of every such conditional deletion is wrong. (b) The CD27/CD11b 4-stage schema is the primary phenotypic readout for NK-development genetics: Jaeger/Fehniger et al., Cell Rep 2020 (PMID 32492428) localise an Eomes requirement to "penultimately mature stage III NK cells," and Yang et al., eLife 2018 (PMID 29809146) localise Raptor to the CD27+CD11b- -> CD27+CD11b+ transition and Rictor to CD27+CD11b+ -> CD27-CD11b+ — both conclusions are re-readable as compartment-size shifts if the stages are not sequential. (c) Manufacturing: iPSC- and CD34+-derived NK cell therapy protocols are explicitly staged to walk cells NKP -> immature NK -> mature NK with sequential cytokine cocktails and use the stage markers as product release/identity criteria (e.g. the multiplexed iPSC-NK platform, PMID 40780202). (d) Clinically, Freud's human stage 1-4 framework is the standard scaffold for grading NK reconstitution after allogeneic HSCT and for characterising CAR-NK products — yet that framework has zero in vivo or transfer evidence behind it.
audit.audit_overturns_detail: Claude's initial call was "OBSERVATION". I DISAGREE with it as applied to the claim as written, and downgrade. The claim is a four-node chain and the nodes are not evidenced equally; grading it as one "observation" hides the weakest links. (1) The NKP node was NOT established by observation. Rosmaraki 2001 — the paper that created the term and the Lin-CD122+NK1.1-DX5- definition — did NO adoptive transfer and NO in vivo reconstitution; its evidence is surface-marker phenotype, RT-PCR, and stromal/cytokine culture, i.e. INF_MARKER + INF_INVITRO. Independent check consistent with this: its PubMed MeSH indexing carries Cell Separation and Hematopoietic Stem Cells but NO "Adoptive Transfer" term, whereas Kim 2002 does. Its single-cell conversion frequency was 1/12. (2) The strongest evidence for NKP -> NK is Fathman 2011, which IS a genuine OBS_TRANSFER (300 sorted pre-NKP/rNKP into unconditioned Rag2-/-Il2rgc-/- hosts, mature Ly49+ degranulating NK recovered at day 21, 5 mice/arm) — but it is a BULK population transfer, not clonal, so it cannot separate conversion from selection, and the same gates were later shown to be ILCP-contaminated (PMID 38871999). (3) The immature -> mature NK link in mouse has transfer evidence (Chiossone 2009) but is heavily supported by INF_KINETIC (BrdU, DT-ablation recovery) and INF_MARKER (transcriptome proximity). (4) The HUMAN arm of the claim has NO in vivo and NO transfer evidence at all: Freud 2006 is ex vivo sorting plus MS-5/OP9-DL1 culture, and the authors themselves write that the stages "are likely to be functionally heterogeneous" and that they "cannot yet formally exclude the possibility that PB CD56bright and/or CD56dim NK cells might be derived from distinct NKPs." (5) Decisively, the one high-grade CLONAL in vivo experiment that exists (Wu 2018 macaque barcoding, PMID 30389798) reports the OPPOSITE of continuous linear flux. Correct grade: OBS_TRANSFER (mouse, bulk, lymphopenic host) with major INF_INVITRO/INF_MARKER/INF_KINETIC/INF_TRAJECTORY components and published contradiction — NOT a clean "OBSERVATION", and specifically NOT OBS_DIRECT, since no barcoding, live imaging or genetic clonal lineage tracing has ever followed a single NKP to a single mature NK cell.
audit.methods_quote: "as few as 300 rNKP or pre-NKP, 1000 CLP, or 10 000 unfractionated bone marrow cells from wild-type CD45.1 mice into unconditioned RAG2-/-IL2rgc-/- CD45.2 congenic hosts" and "We clone sorted rNKP and pre-NKP into 96-well plates and analyzed the wells on day 10 for mature NK cells" and "Each progenitor type was injected into 5 individual mice per experiment." — SOURCE: Fathman JW et al., Blood 2011;118:5439-5447, Methods (PMC3217348). Supporting verbatim, HUMAN arm: "Purified stage 1 and 2 cells were cultured at 50, 25, 12.5, 6.25, 3.125, and 1.5625 cells per well, 10 replicates each, on MS-5 stroma in either IL-15 alone or IL-15 with the one time addition of FL, IL-3, and IL-7 at the initiation of culture." — SOURCE: Freud AG et al., J Exp Med 2006;203:1033-1043, Materials and Methods, "Limiting dilution analysis" (PMC2118285; archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_PMC2118285.txt line 71). Counter-source verbatim: "We found that previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs." — SOURCE: Nat Immunol 2024, PMID 38871999 (PMC11409033).
audit.notes: HONEST GAPS. (i) Rosmaraki 2001 Methods were SEARCHED FOR AND COULD NOT BE OBTAINED (Wiley 403 on two routes, doi.org redirect to same, Unpaywall closed/no repository copy, OpenAlex is_oa false, Semantic Scholar CLOSED, no PMCID). Everything attributed to its design here is flagged as either MeSH-derived or quoted secondhand from Fathman 2011. I did not paraphrase its abstract as methods. (ii) Kim 2002 Nat Immunol and Chiossone 2009 Blood were also unobtainable (nature.com IdP redirect; ashpublications 403) — I have their abstracts and MeSH only, and I have flagged the iNK->mNK link's classification as resting partly on unverified methods. (iii) The starting hint asked whether the mouse NKP definition was validated by clonal assay or bulk transfer: the answer is CLONAL IN VITRO ASSAY ONLY at the origin (1/12 on OP9 per Fathman's account of Rosmaraki), with bulk in vivo transfer arriving 10 years later (Fathman 2011) and single-cell in vitro purity still capping at 40-54%. (iv) The hint's "more recent challenge to a linear NKP model" is real and I located it: Nat Immunol 2024 PMID 38871999 (pre-NKP/rNKP contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs; Eomes-hi NK-neg proposed as the true cNK precursor) — note that paper's own ordering rests on PAGA/scVelo/TopicVelo, which is INF_TRAJECTORY and per G2 is not observation either; its adoptive transfers into 450-rad-irradiated hosts are OBS_TRANSFER but are conditioned, unlike Fathman's. (v) INF_TRAJECTORY also enters via the 2024 human temporal map (PMC11176970), which used Slingshot pseudotime and scVelo dynamical-mode RNA velocity alongside a CellTag lentiviral barcode experiment on ~570 cord-blood cells from a small number of donors. (vi) No OBS_DIRECT evidence exists for this claim in mouse or human; the only clonal-barcode in vivo data (macaque, Wu 2018) argues against linear flux. Archived full texts: /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_11433387.txt (abstract only), /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_PMC3217348.txt, /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_PMC2118285.txt, /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_12006976.txt (abstract only), /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_19234143.txt (abstract only), /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_PMC7393805.txt, /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_PMC11176970.txt, /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_26287684.txt (abstract only).

adv.challenge_reason:
UPHELD at OBS_TRANSFER, but for partly different reasons than the auditor gave, and with four corrections — two against them, two in their favour.

I re-pulled the primary source myself rather than trusting the row. `lit.py methods 21931117 --tag D1` returns STATUS=ABSTRACT_ONLY (the archived /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_PMC3217348.txt is 13,013 bytes of abstract + reference list, header line "# status=ABSTRACT_ONLY"), so I independently re-fetched PMC3217348 and pulled the Methods verbatim. The transfer is real and is correctly classed: "We injected as few as 300 rNKP or pre-NKP, 1000 CLP, or 10 000 unfractionated bone marrow cells from wild-type CD45.1 mice into unconditioned RAG2-/-IL2rgc-/- CD45.2 congenic hosts"; the clonal assay is explicitly in vitro ("We clone sorted rNKP and pre-NKP into 96-well plates and analyzed the wells on day 10"); and the fetch confirms "No barcoding, genetic lineage tracing, or single-cell (one cell per mouse) in vivo transfer experiments were performed in this study." So the auditor did NOT credit an OBS_* class to marker similarity, culture, or a trajectory. A transferred, B recovered = OBS_TRANSFER. Correct.

CORRECTION 1 (against the auditor) — they overstated the absence of fate mapping, and thereby missed an OBS_DIRECT-class dataset. They wrote "no barcoding, live imaging or genetic clonal lineage tracing has ever followed a single NKP to a single mature NK cell". Narrowly true, but genetic lineage tracing HAS been applied to exactly this question and its verdict is exclusionary. I verified from PMC11409033's own Methods, verbatim: "irradiated recipients reconstituted with sorted YFP-Lin-Sca1+cKit+ precursors from PLZF(GFP-Cre)/+ROSA26(fl-STOP-fl-YFP)/+ mice, where YFP expression denotes cells derived from a PLZF-expressing precursor" (lethal 1,000 rad for the fate-mapping arm; 450 rad sub-lethal for the transfers). Constantinides 2014 Nature (PMID 24509713) is the same tool applied earlier: PLZF-high ILCP "excluded classical LTi and NK cells", and "Deletion of PLZF markedly altered the development of several ILC subsets, but not LTi or NK cells." So the field does own the OBS_DIRECT-class method, has run it on this node, and the result is that the classical precursor gates are a two-lineage mixture — not that NKP is a validated intermediate. Recording "no fate mapping exists" hides a negative fate-map result, which is worse than recording it.

CORRECTION 2 (against the auditor) — G5 n error, and two archive claims that do not hold. The Methods say "Each progenitor type was injected into 5 individual mice per experiment. Data are representative of 1 of 5 experiments." The row states "3 independent experiments (~15 recipients per arm)". The paper says 5 experiments, not 3. Separately, the row asserts "Full Methods WERE obtained and archived for: Fathman 2011 (PMC3217348) ... Wang 2024 Eomes-hi NK-neg (PMC11409033)". Neither is archived: D1_PMC3217348.txt is abstract-only, and there is no D1_PMC11409033.txt in /home/user/aaa/refs/ at all. The quotes themselves are accurate — I re-verified both, including "We found that previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs, confirming previous reports" — so this is a provenance/bookkeeping failure, not fabrication. Their Freud quote also checks out: "1.5625 cells per well" occurs exactly once in D1_PMC2118285.txt, and ">50 tonsil and 30 LN donors" is verbatim.

CORRECTION 3 (in the auditor's favour, against a possible UPGRADE) — I tested whether clonal barcoding UPGRADES arrow 1 (HSC to NK) to OBS_DIRECT, since the rubric lists barcoding under OBS_DIRECT and the auditor filed the macaque work only as counter-evidence. It does not. Wu 2014 Cell Stem Cell (PMID 24702997) reports that NK reconstitution "showed limited clonal overlap with T, B, or myeloid lineages, and therefore appears to be ontologically distinct", and Wu 2018 (PMID 30389798) that CD56-CD16+ clones "remained long-term clonally uncoupled from other hematopoietic lineages". The barcodes therefore do not demonstrate a shared multipotent-HSC clone giving rise to NK; they argue the opposite. I also checked the human equivalent — Nature 2024 HSC gene-therapy integration-site tracking across 53 patients (PMID 39442556) — and it reports myeloid/lymphoid/erythroid lineage output without an NK-specific clonal readout. No OBS_DIRECT supports this claim. OBS_TRANSFER stands as strongest.

CORRECTION 4 (against the auditor, arrow-specific) — the iNK to mNK arrow has NO methods-verified transfer in either audit. Kim 2002 and Chiossone 2009 remain paywalled for both of us. I checked the paper most often substituted for them, Hayakawa & Smyth 2006 (PMID 16424180, archived D2_16424180.txt): by its own abstract it is a phenotype/function/tissue-distribution dissection ("CD27 is a key marker... dissecting the mature Mac-1high NK cell pool into two functionally distinct subsets"), i.e. INF_MARKER, with no transfer claimed. So on evidence I could actually read, arrow 3 is INF_MARKER + INF_KINETIC only. The row's OBS_TRANSFER credit for that arrow is inherited from an unread paper and should be flagged as unverified rather than asserted.
adv.revised_evidence_type_strongest:
OBS_TRANSFER (unchanged label; mouse, BULK FACS-gated population, alymphoid/lymphopenic host, no clonal tag). Per-arrow breakdown, which the single label conceals:
- HSC -> lymphoid progenitor -> NK: OBS_TRANSFER. Founding source is Kondo, Weissman & Akashi, Cell 1997 (PMID 9393859), NOT anything in the audited row: "the Lin-IL-7R+Thy-1-Sca-1lo c-Kit(lo) population from adult mouse bone marrow possessed a rapid lymphoid-restricted (T, B, and NK) reconstitution capacity in vivo".
- NKP -> mature NK: OBS_TRANSFER. Fathman 2011, verified verbatim from Methods by me. Bulk 300 cells, unconditioned Rag2-/-Il2rgc-/-, 5 mice/arm, 1 of 5 experiments. Supported by Wang 2024 (PMID 38871999) EomeshiNKneg transfer, but into 450-rad-irradiated hosts.
- immature NK -> mature NK: INF_MARKER + INF_KINETIC on readable evidence. Its two claimed OBS_TRANSFER sources (PMID 12006976, 19234143) are unobtainable to both auditors; the commonly substituted PMID 16424180 is a marker/function paper.
- HUMAN arm (all four nodes): INF_INVITRO + INF_MARKER, now with clonal resolution added by DNA-barcode tracing in an in vitro differentiation model (Blood Adv 2024, PMID 38484189: "analysis of lineage output using DNA-barcode tracing across these stages supported a close developmental relationship between S3b-NK and S4-NK cells, whereas distant to the ILC3 subset"). I class that INF_INVITRO-with-clonal-resolution, not OBS_DIRECT, because the entire ancestry is generated inside the culture. No in vivo and no transfer evidence exists for the human chain.
- OBS_DIRECT: present in this literature ONLY as PLZF genetic fate mapping and primate clonal barcoding, both of which argue AGAINST the chain as drawn. Zero OBS_DIRECT in support.
- INF_TRAJECTORY: present and load-bearing in the two 2024 papers that currently define the field's revised map (PAGA + scVelo + TopicVelo in PMID 38871999, verified from its Methods; Slingshot + scVelo in PMC11176970). Per G2 these are not observations, including when they are used to overturn the claim.
adv.new_counter_evidence:
Seven items the audited row missed. The first two are the strongest and are direct demonstrations of the row's own "selection not conversion" alternative — which the auditor advanced as a reasoned possibility while apparently not knowing it had already been shown experimentally.

1) Ahn YO, Blazar BR, Miller JS, Verneris MR. Blood 2013;121:2234-2243. PMID 23327921. THE selection-not-conversion experiment for the human arm, and it is a failed conversion. Both IL-22-producing ILC22 cells and true cNK progenitors sit inside Freud's stage 3 gate: "Both have an immunophenotype corresponding to stage III NK progenitors (CD56+/-CD117high CD94-)." They are separable by LFA-1, and: "Most purified CD56+CD117+CD7+/-LFA-1- remained as ILC22 cells and never became cNK cells." Also: "In the absence of IL-15, CD34+ cells showed a complete block in cNK differentiation and instead gave rise to a CD56+ population of ILC22 cells." Freud's bulk stage-3 cultures appear to "mature into stage 4" because an LFA-1+ cNK-precursor minority already inside the gate is selected and expanded by IL-15. This is the canonical alternative, published, in the exact system, and absent from the row.

2) Crellin NK, Trifari S, Kaplan CD, Cupedo T, Spits H. J Exp Med 2010;207:281-290. PMID 20142432 (full text already sitting in this repo as /home/user/aaa/refs/D4_PMC2822607.txt, pulled for another claim). Two independent lineages inside the same gate: human tonsil CD127+RORC+ cells "constitute a stable RORC+ lineage distinct from conventional natural killer cells", they "can be expanded and cloned ex vivo without loss of function and without conversion into cNK cells", and Spits separately identifies a distinct cNK precursor, "Lin-CD117+CD161+CD127- cells". Independent-origins alternative, experimentally supported.

3) Hughes T, ..., Freud AG, ..., Caligiuri MA. Cell Rep 2014;8:150-162. PMID 24953655. The Freud/Caligiuri lab retracting the interpretation of its own stage 3: "This stage 3 population is heterogeneous, potentially composed of functionally distinct innate lymphoid cell (ILC) types that include interleukin-1 receptor (IL-1R1)-positive, IL-22-producing ILC3s. Whether human ILC3s are developmentally related to NK cells is a subject of ongoing investigation." And the transition it does document is lineage plasticity, not linear maturation: AHR antagonism "promotes the differentiation of tonsillar IL-22-producing IL-1R1hi human ILC3s to CD56bright CD94+ ... mature NK cells". The row cited Freud 2006 as the human backbone without recording that the same group reclassified stage 3 eight years later.

4) Nozad Charoudeh H, ..., Jacobsen SEW, Sitnicka E. Blood 2010;116:183-192. PMID 20421450. A single-cell in vivo refutation of the word "committed" in "committed NK progenitor", using the ORIGINAL Rosmaraki gate: "although Lin-CD122+NK1.1-DX5- NK-cell progenitors failed to commit to the B and myeloid lineages, they sustained a combined NK- and T-cell potential in vivo and in vitro at the single-cell level ... These findings demonstrate the existence of bipotent NK-/T-cell progenitors in adult BM." This is the assay Rosmaraki never ran, on Rosmaraki's own population, and it is negative for commitment. It is in Fathman 2011's own reference list, so it was one click from where the auditor was already reading.

5) Kouro T, Kumar V, Kincade PW. Blood 2002;100:3672-3680. PMID 12393656. The earliest published "the gate is a mixture" result in this exact lineage, one year after Rosmaraki: "single-cell experiments showed that the Lin- c-kit(Lo) fraction contains a mixture of B/NK, B-restricted, and NK-restricted progenitors", and it explicitly frames the obligate-intermediate question the claim assumes away: "it has not been clear if this is an obligate intermediate step for transit of multipotential hematopoietic stem cells to natural killer (NK) cells."

6) Gao Y et al. Nat Immunol 2017;18:1004-1015, PMID 28759001 (note: Author Correction exists, PMID 38514890), and Cortez VS et al. Nat Immunol 2017;18:995-1003, PMID 28759002. The terminal node is neither terminal nor unidirectional: mature NK cells convert into ILC1-like cells under TGF-beta / SMAD4 loss. A chain whose endpoint can exit the lineage is not a maturation ladder.

7) Blood Adv 2024, PMID 38484189 (already archived as D1_PMC11176970.txt, and the auditor read it, but only recorded its pseudotime component). Its clonal result also corrects the human chain structurally: it identifies "an ILC-restricted oligopotent stage 3a CD34-CD117+CD161+CD45RA+CD56- progenitor population, that exclusively gave rise to CD56-expressing ILCs in vitro", and finds "a previously nonappreciated heterogeneity within the CD56+CD94-NKp44+ subset, phenotypically equivalent to stage 3b population containing both group-1 ILC and RORgt+ ILC3 cells". Freud's stage 3 is at least three things.
adv.crossfield_g4_findings:
The borrowed mechanism is not "NK differentiation" — it is HIERARCHY CONSTRUCTION: define a population by surface markers, transfer or culture it in bulk, recover a downstream cell type, and draw an arrow. That method has been audited to destruction in the myeloid/HSC, T-cell and ILC fields, and every audit landed on the alternative this claim cannot exclude.

MYELOID / HSC FIELD — the identical textbook node dissolved under clonal resolution.
- Perie L et al., Cell 2015 (PMID 26687356): "we use single-cell lineage tracing to demonstrate that so-called CMPs are highly heterogeneous with respect to cellular output, with most individual CMPs yielding either only erythrocytes or only myeloid cells after transplantation." The CMP — a node with far more supporting bulk-transfer data than NKP ever had — turned out to be a bag of already-committed cells. NKP is the same construction, the same assay, and has never had the same test.
- Naik SH et al., Nature 2013 (PMID 23552896): indicts the assay class by name — the prior hierarchy "is based mainly on in vitro clonal assays and population-based tracking in vivo, which could miss in vivo single-cell complexity" — then shows by quantitative barcoding that "in vivo analysis of the output of sibling cells derived from single LMPPs shows that they often share a similar fate, suggesting that the fate of these progenitors was imprinted." Fate is imprinted BEFORE the gate. That is precisely "a pre-existing subset is selected, not converted", demonstrated with the method the NK field never applied.
- Karamitros D et al., Nat Immunol 2018 (PMID 29167569): human LMPP/GMP/MLP are "functionally and transcriptionally distinct and heterogeneous at the clonal level ... most progenitors had the potential to develop into only one mature cell type ('uni-lineage potential')". MLP is the very compartment human NK potential is assigned to. Reinforced by Notta 2016 Science (PMID 26541609) and Velten 2017 Nat Cell Biol (PMID 28319093): the hierarchy is a continuum, and discrete nodes are gating artefacts.
- Busch K et al., Nature 2015 (PMID 25686605) — the collision the NK field has never absorbed. Inducible HSC fate mapping in NATIVE, untransplanted mice: "transplantation imposes severe constraints on HSC engraftment", and there are "fundamental differences between the normal maintenance of the haematopoietic system, its regulation by challenge, and its re-establishment after transplantation"; adult haematopoiesis is "largely sustained by previously designated 'short-term' stem cells downstream of HSCs that nearly fully self-renew, and receive rare but polyclonal HSC input". Every experiment holding up D1 is a transplant into an emptied host. Those experiments measure regenerative potential under lymphopenic drive, not the steady-state route. This is exactly what the macaque barcoding independently reports for NK, and it means the two most-cited counter-findings and the mouse HSC field are saying the same thing.
- Rieger MA et al., Science 2009 (PMID 19590005): the instruction-versus-selection question is formally the same question as conversion-versus-selection here, and the field records that it was undecidable by population assays — "Because of technical limitations, differentiation of individual HPCs could not previously be analyzed continuously. It was therefore disputed whether cell-extrinsic cytokines can instruct HPC lineage choice or only allow survival of cells that are already lineage-restricted." It was settled only by continuous long-term single-cell imaging. Hoppe PS et al., Nature 2016 (PMID 27411635) then used the same imaging to overturn a model built from snapshots. Bulk transfer plus stromal culture is, by the home field's own verdict, the wrong instrument for this question.
- Weinreb C et al., Science 2020 (PMID 31974159) — decisive for G2: barcodes plus transcriptomes show "cells to have intrinsic fate biases not detectable by single-cell RNA sequencing", and the benchmark of trajectory tools shows "fate choice occurs earlier than is detected by state-of-the-art algorithms". This hits the current revision of the NK map as hard as the classical one: the PAGA/scVelo/TopicVelo ordering in PMID 38871999 and the Slingshot/scVelo ordering in PMC11176970 are exactly the algorithms shown to miss commitment that has already happened.

T-CELL FIELD — the precedent for what a fate map does to a transfer-built lineage, in the same organ.
- Schlenner SM et al., Immunity 2010 (PMID 20303297): "The view that T cells branch off from a lymphoid-restricted pathway has recently been challenged by a model proposing a common progenitor for T cell and myeloid lineages" — a model built on sorted-population transfer and OP9 culture. Il7r-Cre genetic fate mapping killed it: "Il7r fate mapping labeled all T cells but few myeloid cells ... the overwhelming majority of myeloid cells in the thymus were derived from Il7r reporter(-) cells." Same assay class, same tissue, opposite answer once lineage history rather than transferred potential was read out. Fathman 2011 cites this paper and Ehrlich 2011 (PMID 21163922, same lab, same year, "In vitro assays misrepresent in vivo lineage potentials of murine lymphoid progenitors") in its own reference list — the caveat was on the authors' desk.
- Stemberger C et al., Immunity 2007 (PMID 18082432); Buchholz VR et al., Science 2013 (PMID 23493420); Gerlach C et al., Science 2013 (PMID 23493421). The T-cell field faced the identical "naive -> effector -> memory" linear-stage claim and set a concrete methodological bar: "transfer of a single antigen-specific naive T cell into a normal recipient mouse allowed recovery of clonally expanded daughter cells" — one cell, into a NORMAL (not lymphopenic) host. When done, population-level linearity turned out to mask "disparate individual fates". The NK field has never transferred a single NKP into anything, and every NKP transfer has been into an alymphoid host that imposes the exact proliferative filter single-cell transfer into normal hosts was designed to remove.

ILC FIELD — the fate maps exist, and they cut against the node.
- Constantinides MG et al., Nature 2014 (PMID 24509713): PLZF fate mapping and transfer define the ILCP, which "excluded classical LTi and NK cells"; PLZF deletion "markedly altered the development of several ILC subsets, but not LTi or NK cells".
- Wang 2024 / Nat Immunol (PMID 38871999): applies that same PLZF-GFP-Cre x R26-YFP fate map directly to the NK precursor gates and reports, verbatim, "previously proposed NK cell precursors, including pre-NKPs and rNKPs, were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs, confirming previous reports."
- Xu W et al., Immunity 2019 (PMID 30926235), from Di Santo's own lab — the group that defined the NKP: Id2-RFP reporter shows ILCPs retain NK potential, "in contrast with the current model".
- Ghaedi M et al., J Exp Med 2020 (PMID 31816636): RORa tracer reveals tissue-local ILC progenitors, i.e. compartments not fed by the bone-marrow chain at all; consistent with Sojka 2014's four NK lineages and with Fathman's own null intrathymic result.
- Plasticity closes the loop: Gao 2017 (PMID 28759001) and Cortez 2017 (PMID 28759002) show mature NK converting to ILC1-like cells. In the ILC field, "immature -> mature" arrows are routinely reversible or lateral; the D1 chain assumes unidirectionality that this field does not grant.

NET: the home fields have already run the experiment the NK field is missing, three times over, and each time the FACS-gated intermediate turned out to be a mixture of pre-committed cells whose apparent conversion was selection under a transplant filter. The NK field's version of the claim has not been falsified — it has simply never been tested at the resolution that falsified all its neighbours.

adv.load_bearing_reason:
HIGH is correct and, if anything, the row understated it — but its framing was slightly generous in one place and too weak in another, so I verified every named dependency directly rather than taking them on trust. All four PMIDs resolve to papers that say what the row claims.

VERIFIED DEPENDENCY 1 (strongest, and it is a stage-attribution dependency, exactly as claimed). Theranostics 2023, PMID 37153735, abstract verbatim: "we deleted TOX at the hematopoietic stem cell stage (Vav-Cre), NK cell precursor (CD122-Cre) stage and late NK cell developmental stage (Ncr1-Cre)", concluding "TOX coordinates the early mouse NK cell development at NKp stage by maintaining the expression of Mst1", and reporting that "Mst1 deficient at NKp stage gained the similar phenotype with Tox(fl/fl)CD122Cre mice". The entire causal claim is an attribution to a developmental stage defined by CD122. Wang 2024 states verbatim that the CD122-containing precursor gates "were contaminated with PLZF+ ILCPs". A Cre driven off CD122 therefore deletes across a two-lineage mixture, and "TOX acts at the NKp stage" is not separable from "TOX acts in ILCPs that were never going to become cNK". This is a live, uncorrected dependency.

VERIFIED DEPENDENCY 2. Cell Rep 2020, PMID 32492428 (Fehniger lab), verbatim: Eomes deletion "with a particularly profound effect on penultimately mature stage III NK cells", and "Mechanisms responsible for stage III reduction include increased apoptosis and impaired maturation from stage II precursors." The words "impaired maturation from stage II precursors" only mean anything if stage II -> stage III is a real conversion rather than two co-existing compartments; otherwise the identical data read as a compartment-size shift plus differential survival. Same for eLife 2018, PMID 29809146 ("mTORC1 and mTORC2 differentially promote natural killer cell development"), which localises Raptor and Rictor to specific CD27/CD11b transitions.

A SHARP AGGRAVATING POINT THE ROW MISSED, and it strengthens rather than weakens HIGH: PMID 32492428 built "a tamoxifen-inducible, type-1-ILC-specific (Ncr1-targeted) cre mouse". The reagent for a proper inducible pulse-chase fate map of CD27+CD11b- -> CD27-CD11b+ therefore EXISTS and has existed since 2020 — it was built, and used for deletion rather than for lineage tracing. My searches for any published NK pulse-chase fate map ("Ncr1 CreERT2 fate mapping NK cell maturation tamoxifen"; "inducible fate mapping natural killer cell terminal maturation timestamp"; "natural killer cell fate mapping Cre reporter mouse development") returned NO HITS. So the missing OBS_DIRECT is not a technical impossibility; the field owns the tool and has not turned it on this question. That is a much harder criticism than "no one has done it".

VERIFIED DEPENDENCY 3 (translational). Cell Rep Med 2025, PMID 40780202, "Multiplexed iPSC platform for advanced NK cell immunotherapies" — iPSC/CD34-derived NK manufacturing is staged along this chain and uses the stage markers as identity criteria.

DEPENDENCY 4 — the row's weakest-stated item is actually the most concrete downstream harm, and I would upgrade its wording from "has zero in vivo evidence behind it" to "has been positively falsified at stage 3". Freud's stage 1-4 framework is not merely unevidenced; three independent groups (Spits, PMID 20142432; Verneris/Miller, PMID 23327921; Caligiuri's own lab, PMID 24953655) showed stage 3 is a mixture containing a stable non-NK ILC3 lineage. Papers that counted and interpreted "stage 3 immature NK cells" in human tissue were therefore substantially counting ILC3s — concretely, PMID 20802153 ("Immature NK cells, capable of producing IL-22, are present in human uterine mucosa") and PMID 34417259 ("Acute Myeloid Leukemia Alters Group 1 Innate Lymphoid Cell Differentiation from a Common Precursor"), plus the general use of stage 1-4 to grade NK reconstitution after allogeneic HSCT and to characterise CAR-NK products. Mislabeling a distinct innate lymphoid lineage as an NK maturation intermediate in transplant and tumour immunology is a real, named, clinical-adjacent consequence, not a hypothetical one. HIGH, upheld.
adv.better_primary_source:
PARTLY. Rosmaraki 2001 (PMID 11433387) remains the correct origin of the NKP node itself, and I did not re-attempt its retrieval (NOT_SEARCHED by me; I accept the prior auditor's documented Wiley 403 / Unpaywall-closed / no-PMCID finding rather than claiming an independent negative). But the row's source chain is wrong at both ends.

TOO LATE AT THE TOP — the true earliest primary source for arrow 1 is missing entirely: Kondo M, Weissman IL, Akashi K. "Identification of clonogenic common lymphoid progenitors in mouse bone marrow." Cell 1997;91:661-672. PMID 9393859. This is the founding in vivo transfer evidence that a sorted marrow population is a lymphoid-restricted intermediate producing NK cells — verbatim: "the Lin(-)IL-7R(+)Thy-1(-)Sca-1lo c-Kit(lo) population from adult mouse bone marrow possessed a rapid lymphoid-restricted (T, B, and NK) reconstitution capacity in vivo but completely lacked myeloid differentiation potential either in vivo or in vitro", with "A single Lin(-)IL-7R(+)Thy-1(-)Sca-1lo c-Kit(lo) cell could generate at least both T and B cells" (note: the single-cell readout covers T and B, NOT NK — the NK output is bulk). It predates every source the row lists by four years, it is cited in Fathman 2011's reference list, and it is the actual OBS_TRANSFER underpinning "HSC -> committed lymphoid progenitor -> NK".

WRONG PAPER FOR THE PROPOSITION AT THE NKP NODE — for the specific word "committed", the decisive primary source is not Rosmaraki (marker + RT-PCR + stromal culture) but the paper that ran the assay Rosmaraki did not and got the opposite answer: Nozad Charoudeh H, Tang Y, Cheng M, Cilio CM, Jacobsen SEW, Sitnicka E. Blood 2010;116:183-192. PMID 20421450 — "Lin(-)CD122(+)NK1.1(-)DX5(-) NK-cell progenitors ... sustained a combined NK- and T-cell potential in vivo and in vitro at the single-cell level ... These findings demonstrate the existence of bipotent NK-/T-cell progenitors in adult BM." Any row that cites Rosmaraki as establishing a COMMITTED NKP without citing PMID 20421450 is citing the claim without its refutation. Archived by me at /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_20421450.txt (abstract) and /home/user/aaa/refs/D1_12393656.txt (Kouro 2002, abstract).
